trials.instruction: Pick the palm-sized red metal Coca-Cola can, put it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, then lift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Grab the can with red body, drop it in the medium basket with smooth texture, and lift the medium basket with smooth texture.
Grab the cylindrical can with bright colors and put it in the yellow basket with open slots, then lift the yellow basket with open slots.
Use the right arm to pick the cylindrical can with smooth surface, drop it into the yellow basket with open slots, then lift the yellow basket with open slots.
Grab the lightweight cylindrical metal can, drop it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, and lift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Pick up the small aluminum can, place it in the oval basket with medium storage space, then lift the oval basket with medium storage space.
Use the right arm to pick the metal can fits easily in hand, place it into the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, and lift the basket.
Grab the can with gold logo design and put it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, then lift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Grab the red can, drop it into the yellow basket with open slots, lift the yellow basket with open slots with another arm.
Use the left arm to grab the small aluminum can, put it in the oval basket with medium storage space, and lift the oval basket with medium storage space.
